hook_text: Six suppliers sent invoices this month. Can you say, right now, exactly what you owe each one?
clip_script: September at Ridgeview Hardware. Six invoices from suppliers, all on credit. Book one, the creditors journal. Each invoice gets a line. The full amount goes in Creditors control, and the same amount again in the column that says what was bought. Stock 15 000. Stationery 600. A tile cutter 3 500. Advertising 900. Add them: 20 000. Matches. Book two, the creditors ledger, a page per supplier. Sides flipped: invoices on the credit side, payments on the debit side. BuildMart: 8 000, paid 5 000, then 2 800 more. Owed 5 800. Book three: Creditors control. 20 000 in, 5 000 paid, 15 000 owed. Add every supplier's page. 15 000. Match. Now you know exactly who to pay.
visual_style: Invoices sliding into a journal, splitting into labelled columns, flowing into five supplier folders, two R15 000 totals clicking together.
pacing: Fast invoice montage, one cross-cast tick, one final matching moment.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and record Ridgeview's September credit purchases yourself.
